$comment: (TJ REL-table) Every release: mod, API, kit and catalogue versions, its date, the feature names added over the previous release (ApiRules), the Steward RC state (pass, pending, none, after-release: a pin run after release under DEV MODE, not-needed, unrecorded: see steward-mc docs/ARCHITECT-ASKS.md) and the package state (ok: tools/pub-verify.mjs passed; partial; unverified). Newest first. tools/release-version.mjs writes a row at every release and regenerates docs/STEWARD-SYNC.md's generated block from this file; history back-filled from the git tags on 2026-11-13 by slice TJ.

notes: RTE5 (v0.89.0 fix check P3): plan_v0 decides a district's architect_mc:district road tag after it stamps street ownership, so a lone b_street in a town zone no longer gets tags it doesn't need (no ownership change; no reader changed). A second compatibility corpus (kit/test/fixtures/rte-compat/rte5.json.gz: 438 cases, 1316 IRs planned and grown by the kits of nine releases v0.48.0-v0.89.0, incl. plan_v0 street flags, bandless extensions, ridge/biome-edge boundaries, seam/reach/gate joins, undo, gapped and mixed-release histories) holds the kit and the mod's DistrictLand to v0.88.0's readings and this tree's writer to v0.89.0's IRs (kitVersion and node aside). No API change.

chore/TI2 (tooling): the test-inputs check resolves computed Path bindings, follows the module closure of node scripts mod tests run and reads fileTree excludes; mod/build.gradle declares the gaps it found (the copied kit, kit/test/h-helpers.mjs, scenarios/bibles); unit-kit and unit-sidecar data hold the directories their tests enumerate; step-inputs check refuses a computed driver path (reading past node preload options); test-trace compares a traced run with the declared inputs, directory listings by the directory rule.
No API change (API stays 1.71.0); kit 0.79.0 (goldens irSha only; tiles, cells and blobs identical).

RTE4: a growth laid from this release on records its district on its boundary street (IR ext architect_mc:district {id}), and a district's street free end and boundary-extension ends read that record (b no longer extends from b_1's grown end); when the untagged readers would give any district's own road to another (b beside b_street, a lone b_street, b_street beside c), the districts pass tags every district's roads with architect_mc:district {id}, read by architect_mc:land (kit and Java DistrictLand) and streetRuns (b no longer takes b_street_w/e; growing b_street no longer refuses NO_ROOM). Every IR saved before reads exactly as v0.88.0, held by a corpus of 408 IRs planned and grown by the v0.85.0-v0.88.0 kits (kit/test/fixtures/rte-compat). No API change.

chore/TI (tooling): the mod test task and step-inputs declare every kit path tests read (kit/lint, kit/examples, delta-fixtures, vocc-designs, kit/massings, kit/schemas, voxel_classes.json, kit/regions; scenario goldens and the af, schem and site fixtures as whole directories); br-unit declares the g7cbr brief styles; step-inputs check fails on an undeclared literal kit/ or scenarios/ test path, and a directory needs an inputs.dir.

chore/GRA (tooling): load-scaled step timeouts measured against the machine's cores (GATE_CPU_CORES), unit-sidecar's limit from its history (ceiling 30 min, 2x wall cap); a TIMEOUT records its wall time, limit and load and is reported apart from a FAIL.
Bundles lab-ui 0.6.2 (LUI3: opt-in Okabe-Ito status dots, the Jobs detail pane's idea dot, KeysOverlay wording settable, WhatsThis's close button at least 20x20).
No API change (API stays 1.71.0); kit 0.78.0 (goldens irSha only; tiles, cells and blobs identical).

RTE3: a following street's groups and a growth's street runs are read from the route tag (id regex only for untagged pieces); a growth's record lists the road groups it laid; architect_mc:land keeps a grouped growth's district band once (kit and Java); a route tag whose edge is not a string reads as untagged in both kit and mod; the mod and gate declare the kit fixtures their tests read. No API change.

Steward rule 11: version skipped for a full RC; smoke on the published jar PASS (stub --only sanity,survival, 2 clients, 19 flows, 105 ok; the 8 module-flow misses were Steward certificate refusals pinned to 0.87.0, not Architect regressions).

RTE2: architect_mc:land ownership from records, not id prefixes: each district gets only its own parts, lots and roads (district b no longer absorbs b_1), a following street belongs to the district its route tag names, a join's long road groups (route_join_<n>_<k>) count as the join, and the join's and a grown part's district are right (kit and Java agree; applies when older regions' land is recomputed). New districts plans skip a piece number that would read as another edge's id, so both RTE limits are gone for new plans (gaps in piece numbers). A long boundary street of a growth keeps architect_mc:street and band on every group. No API change.
LYW3: mega_bench (and mega_bench_forest) report their ring wall as connector.wall with four gates (no towers) in Regions.layout; crater_works' rim stays a tile.

RTE: the kit records each district route piece's edge (IR ext architect_mc:route {edge}); Regions.layout dedups on it: a route drawn whole lists its own road pieces once, inside the route, and never takes another edge's piece; b_1's mixed route is now listed when its edge id equals b's piece id; feature layoutRouteEdges (no API member). Regions planned before keep v0.83.0 shapes. architect_mc:land route parts follow the recorded edge (land.mjs and DistrictLand). Known limits (CONTRACT "Slice RTE"): a roads-only route's piece can still hide a sibling edge's route with the same id; two edges laying the same road id refuse the plan.
chore/TF (tooling): unit-mod cache inputs and the mod test task declare the goldens they read; sidecar jobs.test.ts no longer flakes under load.

SOFF (strict): while any level has saving off (/save-off), Architect holds every operation that changes the stockpile ledger or moves paid items (crate ingress from players and hoppers, payouts, stockpile entries, construction deltas, region fluid charges, the job ticks of placements, builds, fills, roads, repairs and revisions; the start's reconcile and fills are deferred), and releases them only once saving is on everywhere and a confirmed barrier (players, chunks durable, ledger) has passed. /save-off first runs that barrier when the ledger has pending changes. No ledger is published over a level whose chunks were skipped: SaveEvidence records per save which levels were written and whether the players were saved with it, and the world save's callback, saveWithWorld, the durable barrier and Repairs' running marker require it (another mod's forced chunk save no longer publishes the ledger). A fill's in-memory marker advances only once the ledger holding it is on disk. Job ticks hold only while a stockpile ledger stands, so creative placements under /save-off run as before. Gate steps soff-crash (new) and rs-crash items 11b/11c (rewritten for the hold).

Known risks (SOFF final review, Noah's delegation 2026-11-19): (1) introduced by SOFF: if saving is already off when the server starts (only when a mod turns it off at startup; vanilla resets /save-off on restart), the release barrier refreshes the books before the deferred startup reconcile runs, so ahead or lost cells can be missed; (2) the save evidence is one global record, set before the players are saved, so another mod that nests or forces saves from its save hooks can publish the ledger early; (3) the /save-off barrier leaves deposits open during its own save callbacks (a mod inserting items from BEFORE_SAVE); (4) pre-existing on main: a Fills commit ignores a failed ledger write and unlocks anyway (a disk I/O failure); (5) a BEFORE_SAVE listener that turns a level's saving off in the middle of an XR leaves a rollback that keeps the refund. All five remain accepted known risks, scheduled for SOFF2.

Test tooling: gate-run's setupShard resolves the pinned deps (lab_ui, the classpath seed) into each slot's .gradle-home before the sidecar build, so a fresh or stale slot no longer stops on a missing lab_ui (chore/PDS, seen at the v0.84.0 verifier).
No API change (API stays 1.70.0); kit 0.74.0.

PR3: key labels fitted by measured width, not a 9-character cut: long key names ("Mouse Button 4") stay whole where they fit and are cut with "…" by width in the placing and plot HUDs, massing review and the "?" keys overlay (PlacingKeys.fit / fitHints).

LYW2 (LYW's two leftovers): Regions.layout of a walled_hill or sky_isle region lists its ring wall (connector.wall), gate and towers from the new kit IR member walls, instead of one tile (regions planned before stay a tile). Mixed district routes unchanged from v0.83.0 (route-piece dedup deferred until the kit records each piece's edge). Goldens irSha moved for sky_isle and walled_hill (regions-6b).
Bundles lab-ui 0.6.1 (KLW: KeyLabels.label/readable return whole names; KeysOverlay cuts a key wider than its column by width).
No API change (API stays 1.70.0); kit 0.74.0.

RVC (Steward ask 8bS-1): RevisionView.removalStopCause, the typed RemovalStopCause of a revision left waiting (a stopped undo carries its stage removal's cause; any other wait OTHER; null when not waiting), saved with the revision; feature revisionStopCause.

LYW (Steward ask 8bS-2): Regions.layout of a plan/0 walled town carries its wall (connector.wall: ends its foot line, width, height), gates (connector.gate, a gatehouse passage <lot>_passage), corner towers (tower) and wall lots (PartShape.wall/wallAt); routes carry their width; district routes laid as stairs or graded sections are now listed; feature layoutWalls. Bundled programs' walls (walled_hill, sky_isle) still show as one tile.

PR2: player-ready fixes from the v0.82.0 review: text-field clicks at 125/150 % land on the drawn character; End the tour works while paused; placing actions bound to a mouse button fire (MouseHandlerMixin); the style preview clears when its screen is replaced.

Player-ready pass (PR), bundles lab-ui 0.6.0: the build-a-link key moves K -> N (26.3 fires every mapping on one key; defaults are SDL scancodes); a shared Glossary and wording lint (Status > Help, docs/GLOSSARY.md); What's this and a keys overlay on every tab, screen and HUD; a colour-blind-safe ghost palette (opt-in) and ghost cues (refused, blocked, obstructed, hazard); true text scaling at 100/125/150 %; 13 placing, plot and massing actions rebindable under Controls > "Architect: while placing"; a guided first build; style preview on the ghost.

Test tooling: gate-run treats exit 0 with no counts as a failure unless the step is marked counts:false, and unit-scope prints a summed JUnit line (chore/OK0); the fkb-survival swap-window probe waits by time (fix/fkb-swap).
No API change (API stays 1.69.0).

8b settlement data APIs (Steward reviewed): BuildStatus on SiteView/LotState/PartBuild (typed waitsOn, bill_cap with needs and revision, never null); Regions.layout; SETTLEMENT_CHANGED (coalesced, at most one per 20 ticks per owner and region); Sites.checkConnector dry run (never generates terrain; NOT_GENERATED refreshes) and ArchitectClientApi.markConnector; ConnectorRequest gains owner, dimension, actor, maxBill, maxBillPerLot and ext, so a survival connector is capped like a realise; RemovalStopCause (SAVE_REFUSED, PLAYER_IN_BOX, COVERED, CARGO, THINGS_IN_BOX, OTHER). SiteWait.waitingSince now reports one canonical wait start, saved and reloaded. The settlement bill (Regions.bill, TargetBill) is declared but its feature regionBill is not advertised yet (lands after TXN T2b).
API behaviour change: the API placeConnector no longer generates chunks; over ungenerated land it refuses NOT_GENERATED (the player marker still generates).
The 8c kit lane (settle, classify, rivers, waterfalls) is not in this release: it waits until production composition is gated on the flowingWater feature and the catalogue moves to 27.

DFG: adoption no longer loses an unreadable crate's stock: a crate that reads as someone else's, or whose cell can't be read on the server thread, is deferred (left standing, its references kept); a crate known missing and never credited frees its target to the feed, as before. Known gap (TXN T2b): a site completing over a deferred foreign crate still restores its cell.

8c WM (kit only, opt-in per body): the offline flowing-water model (foreign sources, real levels, source conversion, bubble and wash refusals, typed UNSETTLED, ARVX v4 levels). No shipped plan uses it yet; every existing IR is byte-identical.
chore/LT: load-tolerant CPU-time and log-watch tests; the 'crate missing' warning at load now waits for the stockpiles and no longer fires for stockpile-fed sites.

T0: durable saves. DurableFile (OK/REFUSED/IN_DOUBT, folder chain forced), one barrier (players, then chunks, then the ledger), withdraw/dissolve/forced crate removal ledger-first with same-tick restore, and every give-back enters the stock past capacity: nothing drops at the crate and refundOverflow no longer grows (old counts kept).

Known risks (T0): (1) a refused payout whose ledger write is IN_DOUBT and whose compensating rewrite also fails keeps only an in-memory debt, so a restart can lose the refused withdrawal (dissolve: the pile); closed by TXN T1's journal and T2's move onto it. (2) An async chunk serialization failure with no kept copy leaves a stale debt that refuses barriers and payouts until an op forgives it.

Known risks (older paths, assigned): (T2) Fills custody write-back can drop a second copy after a failed ledger save and a crash; (T4) a group removal whose owner's stockpile was dissolved can drop its refund twice across a crash.
8a: staged terrain (ST) and half-built safety (HB) on T0's barrier; 8aF, TO and QX.
T1b: the txn core (txn/ package, recovery table, holds, ResultCache, report-only Conservation), inert outside dev; dev test.move only between single plain chests. SiteWait.TXN_HELD added.

Fix (from 0.78.0, DR-S): an empty removal credit no longer leaves its pending record to be dropped at the next start (no items were minted; only the ledger changed across a clean restart); the start's log says 'nothing to credit' for an empty credit.
Fix (release review): DR2's repair barrier now runs T0's barrier and refuses on owed saves before releasing anything.

Fix (Steward LIFT-S-1, from older code): at world load, a site's build run was cached before the server and the stockpiles were ready, so a partly stocked fill dropped out of outstanding (the build waited forever) and a paid cell vanilla changed (dirt to grass) counted unbuilt or lost. Runs built that early are now dropped and rebuilt once the stockpiles load.

LCAP (S-M5-16): per-lot bill caps (maxBillPerLot); region record ids are reserved at startup; orphan region removal refuses when the sites file is unreadable. Known risk until region removal moves onto TXN: a crash between the queue save and the save clearing the record's unqueued flag, followed later by a missing sites file, lets a built region be removed as an orphan without restore or refund.

DR2: repairs and diagnose ship without the taken-share settle (moved to TXN T6); a removal a player took from stays pending with its whole refund held. Kill points DRK4/6/7 are no longer walked in game.
Process: AGENTS.md rule, never touch the main checkout's branches; cd || exit 1 and set -e in worktree shells.

OVF: a keyed refund never overflows; it all enters the stock, past capacity if need be (usedStacks can exceed capacityStacks). Known risk until TXN: a crash at CS1 inside a construction delta's refund save loses that refund, its overflow share included (on main the overflow dropped as items).
LC3 (late-cargo seal) and PSV (confirmed queue writes) are not in this release: their fix check found open P1s, so per Noah they move to a later release. Steward keeps its late-cargo gap line.
